_about: DECONTAM-ONLY. Frames recalled from memory of public negation benchmarks (CheckList negation tests, NeQA, BLiMP NPI paradigms, Thunder-NUBench, ScoNe-NLG). They were NOT copied from the original files and may differ from them; the local files in negation_benchmarks.json are the authoritative part of check 8.4. Only the 6-word runs of each template's fixed text are used ({x} is a slot that breaks a run); no slot regex is built, so a template never bans a whole construction.
templates: I would never say that I {x} this {x}.
It isn't true that I {x} this {x}.
I thought the {x} would be {x}, but it wasn't.
